'''Roccus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Roccus system]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to one of [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]]' [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|service platforms]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although its system is mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the planet is not mentioned. Only the Twin Sun Station is mentioned.

[[File:TwinSunVid2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Roccus, as seen from [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Sun Station's]] command center.]]
